name: Nick Dreyer
title: Co-founder
bio: Nick Dreyer is a global growth strategist and co-founder of Made in RSA, where he helps South African brands turn local credibility into international revenue. Before this, he co-built Veldskoen into a globally recognised brand, backed by Nando’s, DHL and Olympic teams. Through the Made in RSA Growth System, he helps founder-led businesses clarify their global story, build the operational and commercial engine, and launch in USD and GBP markets with sell-through infrastructure. He is currently scaling 18+ South African brands across the US and UK, with clients reporting hard-currency sales within 4 to 8 weeks and 50+ stockists in under 12 months. He believes in structure over chaos and clarity before speed.
